text: Montreal Music Labs created the Articulations controller touchscreen app for virtual instruments.
The Articulations app allows users to access all their articulations and key switches from one simple interface.
Montreal Music Labs is based in Montreal, Canada.
The funding for the Articulations project was canceled by the project creator on December 20, 2019.
The funding period for the Articulations project was from November 20, 2019, to December 20, 2019.
The Articulations project had a funding goal of $17,653.
The Articulations project received $3,185 in pledges from 89 backers.
Montreal Music Labs' first major release was VM1, an iPad controller application for VSL's Vienna Ensemble Pro 7.

Montreal Music Labs is developing the Articulate App.
Articulate is an integrated AU/VST/AAX plugin and touchscreen app solution.
Articulate provides Music Composers quick control with minimal user configuration.
Articulate displays all instrument articulations on the iPad as simple buttons.
Articulate allows users to store selected articulations as automation in their DAW.
Articulate is a solution that gives Music Composers quick control with minimal user configuration.
Articulate allows all instrument articulations to appear on the iPad as simple buttons.
Selecting a desired articulation in Articulate stores it as automation in the DAW, not MIDI.
Articulate enables easier editing and standard automation functions such as touch, latch, and overwrite.
A post-release update will allow control of the most relevant parameters of the plugin directly from Articulate.
The preliminary work on Articulate has been completed, and the product code is currently being refined.
A beta version of the application is planned to be released to testers in early 2020.
The official release of Articulate to all users is planned for March 2020.
